options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:arch-reviewer
options.description: Checks a pipeline branch against the architecture document, lists the new concepts it introduces, and decides fits, needs-change or escalate. Read-only. Use for the architecture step of a pipeline PR.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:bot-answerer
options.description: Answers the review bots' comments on a pipeline PR: fixes what is right, replies on every thread. Use for the bot answer step of a pipeline PR.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:bot-waiter
options.description: Waits for the review bots on a pipeline PR and counts their open comments. Changes nothing. Use for the bot wait step of a pipeline PR.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:docs-reviewer
options.description: Checks the docs commits a docs-writer added to a pipeline branch against the code they describe. Read-only. Use for the docs check of a pipeline PR.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:docs-writer
options.description: Brings a repo's docs (README, markdown docs, docs site) in line with a pipeline PR that passed review, on the same branch. Changes no code. Use for the docs step of a pipeline PR.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:evals-writer
options.description: Writes the list of evals for one pipeline PR before it is built: plain sentences that say what must be true, each with a check. Reads the default branch only. Use for the evals step of a pipeline PR.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:evaluator
options.description: Reads the results of a finished pipeline wave and returns feedback items about the pipeline itself, plus the paths the wave changed. Read-only. Use for the end-of-run evaluation step.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:feedback-redactor
options.description: Rewrites pipeline feedback items so they hold nothing from the repo the wave ran in. Changes nothing. Use before feedback from another repo is filed.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:fixer
options.description: Fixes the blockers, majors and failing checks a pipeline review round found, with new commits on the same branch. Use for the fix step of a pipeline PR.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:goals-preflight
options.description: Checks that a repo's product goals document exists and has Goals and Non-goals items. Changes nothing. Use for the preflight step of a pipeline wave.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:implementer
options.description: Builds one plan entry of the agent PR pipeline on its own branch, with unit tests and the acceptance test, and pushes the branch. Use for the implement step of a pipeline PR.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:land-fixer
options.description: Brings one pipeline PR to a mergeable state with green CI: merges the default branch in or fixes a CI failure. Never merges. Use when the land script reports LAND FIX.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:merge-safety
options.description: Decides whether one PR that the path gate did not hold is safe for an agent to merge, or needs the maintainer. Read-only. Use for the merge-safety step of a pipeline PR.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:pipeline-io
options.description: Runs one of the plugin's GitHub scripts through io.sh and returns what it printed, with no judgment. Use when the workflow needs the output of a script such as quick-brief.sh, gate-files.sh, bot-status.sh or land-commits.sh.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:pr-opener
options.description: Opens the pull request for a pipeline branch, posts one checklist comment and files only the minor findings its task lists. Changes no code. Use for the open step of a pipeline PR.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:product-reviewer
options.description: Checks a pipeline plan (or PR) against the product goals and non-goals and decides aligned, notes or escalate. Read-only. Use for the product-fit step of a pipeline plan PR.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:qa
options.description: Uses a pipeline branch's built feature like a user (runs the commands, the edge cases, the error paths) and checks it does what the plan entry and the docs say. Changes no code. Use for the QA step of a pipeline PR.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:reviewer
options.description: Reviews a pipeline branch adversarially against the spec and the plan entry and ranks findings blocker, major or minor. Read-only. Use for the review step of a pipeline PR, for code, docs and plan PRs.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:tester
options.description: Tests a pipeline branch from a clean clone: runs the fast checks, the branch's own e2e files and up to 10 related test files, and reports each result. Changes no code. Use for the test step of a pipeline PR.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:triager
options.description: Reads one GitHub issue, the code and the goals document, and decides build, plan or decline, with size and risk and, for build, a plan entry. Read-only. Use for the triage step of a quick fix.

options.name: agent-pr-pipeline:verifier
options.description: Verifies a pipeline branch from a clean clone: runs the fast checks, the branch's own e2e files, up to 10 related test files and the check of every eval, and reports a result for each eval id. Changes no code. Use for the verify step of a pipeline PR that has an eval list.

availableCommands.name: agent-pr-pipeline:run-wave
availableCommands.description: Build, test, review and fix one wave of PRs, open them and answer the review bots; each step a separate agent (dynamic workflow)

availableCommands.name: agent-pr-pipeline:cloud-routines
availableCommands.description: (agent-pr-pipeline) Create, update, list, pause, turn off and on the Claude Code cloud routines and the cloud environment of a repo that uses the agent-pr-pipeline. Use when the user asks to set up the cloud routines for a repo, change their schedule or prompt, move a repo to a new pipeline release, or pause them. Only the maintainer's main session runs it; a cloud session never does.

availableCommands.name: agent-pr-pipeline:pr-pipeline
availableCommands.description: (agent-pr-pipeline) Plan and build a release or a batch of changes as small PRs, where separate agents implement, test from a clean clone, review adversarially, fix, open the PR, answer review bots and bring it to green CI. A scripted path gate and a merge-safety agent decide which PRs an agent may merge; the maintainer merges the rest, and the main session lands them and runs the release script. Use when the user asks to plan and build a release, a milestone or a set of issues "with the usual workflow", to run waves of PRs through review, or to set up this loop in a new repo. Not for a single quick fix by hand; one issue without a plan goes through the `quick` option of a wave, which triages it first.

availableCommands.name: agent-pr-pipeline:write-goals
availableCommands.description: (agent-pr-pipeline) Interview the maintainer and write the product goals document (Goals, Non-goals, Users, How to change this file) that the agent-pr-pipeline skill needs before its first run, then check it. Use when a repo has no goals document, when the pipeline refuses with "goals document missing or incomplete", or when the user asks to write or redo the product goals. It never invents goals; it asks.
